post_freeze_refinements_disclosed: Tightening only: supervisor coverage_history gap pids must each appear in the parent identity union (else IDENTITY_UNION_INVALID); union status then decides blocking. Reason: package v9 says historical failed coverage stays visible and blocking; only the parent's external union can classify it.

Tightening only: receipt timing_failed true, history_overflow non-null or nonempty raw_acquisitions => HELD RECEIPT_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE (v17: pending raw/nullable evidence is HOLD, never healthy evidence).

import_map.no_imports: No os/sys/time/subprocess/threading/socket. No module is imported by path; no source is compiled or executed by the bridge.

consumes_interfaces.reader: beta_parent_reader_v1 EvidenceReader instance owned by caller: read_bytes(path:str, cap:int)->bytes; last_file(path)->dict|None; report()->dict. Only these three; never constructed/closed by the bridge.

import_map.feeds: beta_parent_adapter_v3.evaluate_pinned(inputs, reader, deadline_check) where inputs = result['adapter3_inputs'] ONLY after the parent exclusively publishes each result['records'][name]['text'] encoded ASCII at its path and authenticates the readback. The bridge publishes nothing.

request_ref: exact {path:normalized absolute str, sha256:lowercase hex64}; caller vouches the SHA as parent authority

request_schema.item: exact plan v5 job item (calibrations rejected)
request_schema.plan: exact ref equal to {path: MOLS39 plan v5 path, sha256: 254b44c3...}
request_schema.job_dir: normalized absolute; PLAN: equal to the plan job's single --job-root argument; FIXTURE: not equal/below plan base_dir or audit_dir
request_schema.parent_wait: ref to PRT wait doc exact {format:'parent-release-wait-v1',item,role:'driver',pid:int>0,pgid:int>0,start_fingerprint:nonempty str,raw_status:int in [0,2^31),actual_exit:int,observed_by:'parent'} for the supervisor process
request_schema.parent_captures: exact {stdout,stderr}; each V9 exact {path,sha256,bytes:int>=0,inode:[dev:int>=0,ino:int>0],eof:true}; distinct paths and inodes
request_schema.context: exact {original_dm21:ref, prefix:list of exact {item, files:{name:ref}, audit:ref}}
request_schema.publish_paths: exact {expectation,observation,context}: distinct normalized absolute, not equal/below job_dir, not any bridge-acquired path

union_schema.completeness: literal PARENT_ATTESTED_COMPLETE_HISTORICAL_UNION (attestation is the parent's CP2 obligation; never verified here)
union_schema.constraints: pid/pgid int>0; start_fingerprint and source nonempty str; uniqueid int>0 or null; unique (pid,start_fingerprint); unique non-null uniqueid; exactly one driver row equal to parent_wait pid/pgid/start_fingerprint; row with child uniqueid has role main_child; every receipt identity (child, owned_identities, unproved_history, helpers by uniqueid or by pid when identity null, final and ACK census live arrays) present with equal pid; every coverage_history gap pid present

actual_evidence_derivation.receipt: request.publication.receipt path; reader bytes sha/len and last_file dev/ino/nlink/size must equal the binding
actual_evidence_derivation.actual_go: actual config admission.go_path with sha receipt.authorization.go_sha256; must carry mode and plan_sha256 (beta binding fields; supervisor allows extra GO keys)
actual_evidence_derivation.launch_record: actual config launch_record with sha receipt.launch_record_sha256
actual_evidence_derivation.main_captures: actual config stdout/stderr paths; bytes sha/len equal stream sha256_written/bytes_written; last_file dev/ino equal receipt artifacts[path].inode (supervisor checked == original created ident); nlink 1
actual_evidence_derivation.ack: parent stdout capture bytes: exactly one LF-terminated strict JSON successful ACK object

caps_bytes.assignments: request, plan, GO, config, wait doc, launch record, freeze, DM21, prefix audits: 1 MiB; receipt, parent captures, MAIN capture files, union, prefix files: 16 MiB (reader maximum). Larger evidence => READ_FAILED => HELD.

held_causes_in_order.AUTHORITY_PIN_MISMATCH: plan ref or receipt supervisor pin differs from module constants
held_causes_in_order.SUPERVISOR_CAPTURE_UNBOUND: V9 parent capture schema/bytes/identity, stderr nonempty
held_causes_in_order.SUPERVISOR_ACK_INVALID: stdout not exactly one successful ACK or ACK joins fail
held_causes_in_order.SUPERVISOR_EXIT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: parent actual supervisor exit not 0/11 (10 maps to NESTED_EXIT_UNAVAILABLE)
held_causes_in_order.RECEIPT_UNBOUND: receipt bytes/identity differ from parent publication binding
held_causes_in_order.RECEIPT_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: timing_failed, history_overflow or pending raw acquisitions
held_causes_in_order.NESTED_EXIT_UNAVAILABLE: no reaped nested child exit or inconsistent native wait
held_causes_in_order.MAIN_STREAM_UNBOUND: missing/ambiguous/inconsistent MAIN stream or capture file identity
held_causes_in_order.DATE_UNAVAILABLE: receipt start/end owned date missing or malformed
held_causes_in_order.PIN_CLASSIFICATION_INVALID: actual pin unclassified or duplicate conflict
held_causes_in_order.FREEZE_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE: freeze immutable_paths omit a bridge or predicted adapter3 acquisition
held_causes_in_order.READ_FAILED: reader raised, or current completed acquisition not established, or stricter cap conflict
held_causes_in_order.READER_UNRESOLVED: final caller reader report has unresolved resources or is unavailable
held_causes_in_order.BRIDGE_INTERNAL_EXCEPTION: any other Exception inside the bridge (fail closed)

observation.actual_exit: receipt main_wait rc (nested child; negative = signal)
observation.captures: {stdout,stderr}: {present:true, path: actual config path, sha256: sha256_written, bytes_seen, bytes_stored: bytes_written, eof: eof_seen, overflow, error}
observation.artifacts: per actual config output with dict receipt record {path,sha256,bytes,ino:inode[1],nlink}; null record omitted (truthful absence)
observation.receipt: {path: bound receipt path, sha256: bound receipt sha}
observation.settlement: {reaped:true, group_empty: final and ACK census group_live empty, census_complete: final and ACK census complete, unresolved: sorted unique labels, signals: sorted unique labels}
observation.source_pins/input_pins: actual config pins classified by request map keys
observation.date_start/date_end: {kind:'SUPERVISOR19_OWNED_BIN_DATE', purpose:'start'|'end', text: receipt date text, receipt_sha256: bound receipt sha}

context.prefix: request.context.prefix (rows exactly plan order[:position], files exactly plan outputs, all refs sha-verified)

freeze_required_coverage: every bridge acquisition (request, plan, expected/actual GO and config, wait doc, parent captures, receipt, launch record, MAIN capture files, union, freeze, DM21, prefix files/audits) plus predicted adapter3 acquisitions: publish paths, capture4, schema2, ext4 gate, plan, DM21, prefix refs, expected job_dir/output names, expected capture and receipt paths, actual capture paths and bound receipt path, every expected and actual pin path

result_schema.state: READY only if no cause fired and the final original-deadline check after full assembly passed; else HELD
result_schema.records: null unless READY; {expectation,observation,context}: {path, sha256, length, text}; text = canonical json.dumps(sort_keys, separators (',',':'), ensure_ascii, allow_nan False) + LF
result_schema.consumed: acquisition order list {roles, path, sha256, length, metadata:{dev,ino,nlink,size,mtime_ns,ctime_ns}}

never: infer authenticity from JSON or hash equality
fabricate exit, capture, date, identity, settlement or provenance
write, publish, launch, signal, sleep, read clocks
close or replace the caller reader
verification_boundary: Interface frozen by reading only. No execution/import/compile/AST/tests.
